from callscope.service import AnalysisService
from pathlib import Path
import json
service = AnalysisService('/tmp/callscope-n0vel-evaluation/target', '/tmp/callscope-codegraph-build/formal-v15/n0vel.sqlite3', engine='full')
try:
    result = service.scan()
    Path('/tmp/callscope-codegraph-build/formal-v15/full_repeat.json').write_text(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + chr(10))
    print(json.dumps({'snapshot_id': result['snapshot_id'], 'created': result['created'],
        'finding_count': result['finding_count'], 'maintenance': result['maintenance']}))
finally:
    service.store.close()
